readings: Considering only race results where the starting grid position is strictly greater than 12 (grid > 12), group by driver. For each driver, sum their points and average their `laps` (ignoring NULL values). Then return one unrounded row: the average of those per-driver points totals and the average of those per-driver average laps.

Considering only race results where the starting grid position is 12 or higher (grid >= 12), group by driver. For each driver, sum their points and average their `laps` (ignoring NULL values). Then return one unrounded row: the average of those per-driver points totals and the average of those per-driver average laps.
queries:
SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_avg_laps
FROM (
  SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM results
  WHERE grid > 12
  GROUP BY driverId
);
SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_avg_laps
FROM (
  SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM results
  WHERE grid >= 12
  GROUP BY driverId
);
